profile.name: GenICam工业相机
profile.description: 一种遵循 GenICam/GenTL 标准进行图像传输的工业相机或机器视觉相机，用于实验室中的显微成像、样品观察、过程记录和自动化视觉检测，可进行单帧或连续图像采集。
profile.description_en: An industrial or machine-vision camera that transfers images through the GenICam/GenTL standard. It is used in laboratories for microscopy imaging, sample observation, process documentation, and automated visual inspection, supporting single-frame or continuous image acquisition.
